Mine & location: Central Queensland Coal Associates joint venture
Mine type & mineralisation style: Mining leases, including undeveloped tenements, expire between 2018 and 2043. All leases are renewable.
Power source: Goonyella Riverside: Goonyella open cut mine commenced in 1972; Riverside open cut mine commenced in 1976. Both mines operated by BMA. Broadmeadow underground mine commenced in 2005, operated by BMA. Daunia open cut mine commenced in 2013 and operated by BMA.
Facilities, use & condition: Goonyella: Coal is transported via rail to Dalrymple Bay Coal Terminal (DBCT) for export. Riverside: Coal is transported via rail to DBCT for export. Broadmeadow: Coal is transported via conveyor belt to Goonyella coal handling plant, then via rail to DBCT for export.
